Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Langston Galloway?

Langston Galloway is 34 years old.

Where was Langston Galloway born?

Langston Galloway was born in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

When was Langston Galloway born?

Langston Galloway was born on December 9, 1991.

How tall is Langston Galloway?

Langston Galloway is 6-1 (185 cm) tall.

How much did Langston Galloway weigh when playing?

Langston Galloway weighed 200 lbs (90 kg) when playing.

Is Langston Galloway in the Hall of Fame?

Langston Galloway is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did Langston Galloway play?

Shooting Guard and Point Guard.

When did Langston Galloway retire?

Langston Galloway last played in 2022.

What is Langston Galloway's net worth?

Langston Galloway made at least $29,287,512 playing professional basketball.

How much did Langston Galloway make?

Langston Galloway made $7,333,333 in 2020.

What did Langston Galloway average?

Langston Galloway averaged 8.1 points, 2.4 rebounds, and 1.6 assists per game.

How many rings does Langston Galloway have?

Langston Galloway won 0 championships.

What is Langston Galloway's Instagram account?

Langston Galloway is on Instagram at langgalloway10.

What schools did Langston Galloway attend?

Langston Galloway attended Christian Life Academy in Baton Rouge, Louisiana and Saint Joseph's.
